# Adstart — TikTok Ads guide

> An independent informational page about getting started with TikTok Ads: creating an advertiser account,
> the new advertiser ad credit tiers, and exploring campaign setup in TikTok Ads Manager.
> This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by TikTok.

## Key facts

- Site: https://tiktok-ads.online/
- Languages: English (en), Español México (es-MX), Bahasa Indonesia (id), Português Brasil (pt-BR), Русский (ru)
- Type: independent informational resource (no services sold, no accounts opened here)
- Registration for a TikTok Ads account happens on TikTok's own website
- New advertiser offer shown on the page: up to $6,000 in ad credits (not guaranteed)
- Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Sections (anchors on each page)

- #offer: credit tiers for new advertisers
- #how-it-works: three steps — create the account on TikTok, add business details, explore campaign setup
- #tools / #benefits: what the tools in Ads Manager are for
- #faq: registration location, required information, cost, credits, affiliation

## FAQ (English, short answers)

- Where do I register for a TikTok Ads account? Use the button on this page to continue to TikTok’s registration flow. Account registration takes place on TikTok’s website.
- What information will I need? TikTok will guide you through the information needed for your account. Requirements may vary depending on your country and business type.
- How much does it cost to run ads? Campaign costs depend on the settings you choose and the options available to your account. Review current budget and billing details in TikTok Ads Manager before launching a campaign.
- Are the new advertiser ad credits guaranteed? No. The spend tiers shown here are a guide to the incentive details supplied for this page. TikTok’s offer shown during registration and its terms control. Eligibility, qualifying spend windows, availability, and reward timing may vary by advertiser and region.
- Is this an official TikTok website? No. This is an independent informational page. TikTok Ads accounts, approval, features, and availability are managed by TikTok and may vary by country.
